summary: test_2119_skills_publish_spec_and_review_material does exact-string equality of each built-in workflow's review-skill instructions against a hardcoded expected string containing the verbatim 'End the triage summary PR comment with a "Suggested placeholder issues" section' clause; in-process mutation removing the end-with requirement (replacing it with 'include somewhere') produces instructions that fail the equality check, confirming genuine detection.
